title: Seljuks defeat the Byzantines at Manzikert
summary: The Seljuk sultan Alp Arslan defeated a Byzantine army and captured Emperor Romanos IV Diogenes near Manzikert in eastern Anatolia.
reason: Romanos marched east to stop Turkish raids into Byzantine Armenia and Anatolia.
significance: It opened Anatolia to Turkish settlement and led Byzantium to ask the West for help, a cause of the Crusades.
